tracker: Finite-horizon time-varying LQR plus time-varying linear KF around a native nonlinear motor-generated jump reference; not contact NMPC or global recovery.
scope: Known nominal physical jump with new measurement-noise seeds; no injected external force, pose reset, hardware authority or solution of the separate 40N recovery task. Reference generation may use true state offline; runtime controller receives only estimated state.

derivativePolicy.scope: Branch-consistent local finite differences; not a guarantee the noisy trajectory stays on the nominal branch

trackerCostSource: Existing recovery profile Q/R and terminalP; no retuning on assessment noise
